findings.description: comp_tickets only calls require_login, so any logged-in attendee can issue free tickets to any holder, up to 50 per request, and repeat the call until the event is sold out. Other privileged routes (cancel_event, attendee_list) use require_role, so this route is the odd one out.
findings.suggestion: Replace require_login with require_role(request.user, Role.STAFF, Role.ADMIN) and then use the returned user for issued_by.
findings.title: Complimentary ticket endpoint lacks role authorization
